# Hofstra University

> Hofstra University is a comprehensive private research institution on Long Island offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across liberal arts, business, law, medicine, and education.

Hofstra serves students from the New York metropolitan area and beyond, with particular strength in professional schools including the Maurice A. Deane School of Law and Zucker School of Medicine. The university offers flexible learning options including distance education, continuing education, and honors programs.

## Admissions

- [Admission](https://www.hofstra.edu/admission): Main admission hub for undergraduate, graduate, and international student applications.
- [Undergraduate Admission](https://www.hofstra.edu/admission/undergraduate-admission): Undergraduate admission information including majors, campus life, and application guidance.
- [Application Process](https://www.hofstra.edu/admission/apply): Guide to Hofstra application process using Common App and Hofstra App with test-optional policy.
- [Graduate Admission](https://www.hofstra.edu/admission/graduate-admission): Graduate admission for doctoral, MBA, journalism, and online part-time programs.
- [International Student Admission](https://www.hofstra.edu/admission/international.html): International student admission including visa, I-20 forms, and scholarship information.
- [Transfer Student Appointments](https://www.hofstra.edu/admission/transfer-appointments.html): Transfer student appointment scheduling and guidance through Virtual Transfer Days.

## Professional Schools

- [Maurice A. Deane School of Law](https://law.hofstra.edu): Hofstra Law School homepage featuring JD programs, admissions, and legal clinics.
- [Zucker School of Medicine](https://medicine.hofstra.edu): Zucker School of Medicine homepage with medical education, research, and admissions.

## Academics

- [Academics](https://www.hofstra.edu/academics): Academic overview with colleges, schools, programs, and career development resources.
- [Colleges and Schools](https://www.hofstra.edu/academics/colleges-and-schools): Directory of Hofstra's colleges and schools including Liberal Arts, Government, and Arts.
- [Academic Offerings](https://www.hofstra.edu/academics/academic-offerings): Complete academic program listings including honors college and dual-degree options.
- [Distance Learning](https://www.hofstra.edu/academics/distance-learning): Online and hybrid degree programs across education, business, health sciences, and law.
- [Academic Calendar](https://www.hofstra.edu/academics/calendar): Academic calendar with semester schedules, deadlines, and registration dates.
- [Academic Support](https://www.hofstra.edu/academics/academic-support): Academic support services including tutoring, advising, and Center for Academic Excellence.

## Financial Aid and Affordability

- [Make Hofstra Affordable](https://www.hofstra.edu/admission/make-hofstra-affordable): Financial aid, scholarships, FAFSA information, and payment plan options for students.

## Continuing Education and Learning

- [Continuing Education](https://ce.hofstra.edu): Continuing education programs including Hofstra EDGE, summer camps, and professional development.

## Campus Resources

- [Campus Life](https://www.hofstra.edu/campus-life): Campus life including housing, clubs, dining, health services, and student activities.
- [University Libraries](https://www.hofstra.edu/library): Hofstra University Libraries with research resources, databases, and research guides.
